amplitude_source: physical_wave_gait_quadruped._gait_amplitude with the existing SWING_TICKS=72 as its amplitude-duration cycle_ticks argument; actual gait period remains 360
rule: Change only the smooth resumed-walking amplitude ramp duration from one gait cycle to the first scheduled swing. Amplitude remains exactly zero at local 1 and reaches one at local 73. Preserve clocked progression through local 360, contact-gated progression from 361, zero-phase resumed startup, memory continuity, native contact inputs, V27 recovery and stance commands, motor limits, retained horizon and every evaluator. Retain every startup sample and negative. No body or velocity reset.
parameter_basis: 72 is the existing SWING_TICKS/SWING_STEPS of the frozen normal launcher and Rust gait, not a fitted success or contact threshold. The hypothesis is that the first intended swing should receive a complete smooth activation rather than spending its entire duration below 10.14 percent amplitude. This is not proof that it will release the foot, preserve support, complete two cycles or improve walking.
compatibility_scope: The existing zero-phase start and local-361 adapter-memory operation are reused explicitly because their phase clocks and transition boundary are unchanged. Their old contracts and all old entry-profile semantics stay exact. The new amplitude identity is retained and replayed as distinct; it is never substituted into an observed record.
